analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Ensure that the ARCH-V21 and ARCH-V18 fixes are correctly implemented, specifically focusing on skipping catchall macros, performing proportional skew checks, and ensuring there are no orphan contract owners.
requirements_understanding: The fixes must ensure that catchall macros are not executed.
Proportional skew checks must be implemented to maintain system balance.
All contract owners must be linked appropriately, with no orphaned entities.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement validation to skip catchall macros.
Develop a mechanism to perform proportional skew checks.
Create a process to verify and link contract owners, ensuring no orphaned entities.
clarifications_requested: What specific metrics define a 'proportional skew'?
Are there existing logs or data to identify orphan contract owners?

executive_summary: This document outlines the requirements to verify and implement fixes for ARCH-V21 and ARCH-V18, focusing on skipping catchall macros, performing proportional skew checks, and ensuring no orphan contract owners.

functional_requirements.title: Skip Catchall Macros
functional_requirements.description: Ensure that the system skips execution of catchall macros during processing.
acceptance_criteria: System logs show no execution of catchall macros.
Catchall macros are identified and flagged in the codebase.
Automated tests confirm macros are skipped in all scenarios.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Proportional Skew Check
functional_requirements.description: Develop a mechanism to perform proportional skew checks to maintain balance in the system.
acceptance_criteria: Proportional skew checks are executed during each relevant transaction.
Alerts are generated if skew exceeds defined thresholds.
Reports provide a summary of skew checks and outcomes.

functional_requirements.title: Ensure No Orphan Contract Owners
functional_requirements.description: Verify all contract owners are linked and no orphan entities exist.
acceptance_criteria: Database queries confirm no orphan contract owners.
Reports list all contract owners and their associations.
Automated checks ensure new contracts are linked correctly.

functional_requirements.title: Logging for Skipped Macros
functional_requirements.description: Implement logging to track when macros are skipped.
acceptance_criteria: Logs capture every instance of a skipped macro.
Logs are accessible and searchable by administrators.
Alerts are sent if unexpected macros are executed.

functional_requirements.title: Automated Testing for Skew Checks
functional_requirements.description: Create automated tests to validate proportional skew checks.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover all scenarios for skew checks.
Test results are logged and reviewed regularly.
Failures in skew checks trigger alerts and logs.

functional_requirements.title: Contract Owner Verification Process
functional_requirements.description: Establish a process to verify and correct contract owner links.
acceptance_criteria: Verification process is documented and accessible.
Regular audits confirm no orphan contract owners.
Discrepancies are resolved within a defined timeframe.

functional_requirements.title: User Interface for Skew Check Results
functional_requirements.description: Provide a user interface to display results of skew checks.
acceptance_criteria: UI displays real-time skew check results.
Users can filter and search skew check data.
Access to UI is restricted to authorized personnel.

functional_requirements.title: Alert System for Orphan Contract Owners
functional_requirements.description: Implement an alert system to notify administrators of orphan contract owners.
acceptance_criteria: Alerts are generated when orphan contract owners are detected.
Administrators receive alerts via email and dashboard notifications.
Alerts include details necessary for resolution.

non_functional_requirements.title: System Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the system performs skew checks without impacting overall performance.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests confirm skew checks execute within target time.
No degradation in system performance during peak loads.
Performance metrics are logged and reviewed monthly.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security of Contract Data
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure contract data is secure and protected against unauthorized access.
non_functional_requirements.metric: All contract data access is logged and monitored.
acceptance_criteria: Security audits confirm no unauthorized data access.
Access logs are reviewed weekly by security team.
Data encryption is verified for all contract data.

non_functional_requirements.title: System Reliability
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure system reliability during skew checks and macro skipping.
acceptance_criteria: System monitoring confirms uptime targets are met.
Incident reports are reviewed and resolved within SLA.
Redundancy measures are in place and tested quarterly.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability of Skew Check Interface
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the skew check interface is user-friendly and intuitive.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback sessions confirm ease of use.
Interface meets accessibility standards.
Training materials are available and up-to-date.
non_functional_requirements.verification: User feedback sessions and accessibility audits.

non_functional_requirements.title: Observability of Macro Skipping
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure observability of macro skipping through comprehensive logging.
acceptance_criteria: Logs capture all macro skipping events.
Logs are reviewed weekly by the operations team.
Anomalies in logs are flagged and investigated promptly.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Log review and anomaly detection tests.

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.
